subject: Workstation never wakes up
description: The monitor and phone charger at my desk have power, but pressing the button on the computer itself produces no lights or sound.

subject: Tower stopped responding
description: I shut the PC down before moving some papers around my desk. Now the system unit will not react when I try to start it.

subject: PC died and stayed dead
description: The workstation suddenly went off yesterday and has shown no signs of power since, even though the outlet is working.

subject: Screen disappeared but call stayed connected
description: The monitor went dark during a meeting, but I could still hear the conversation and the computer itself remained on.

subject: No image from active workstation
description: The fans are spinning and I hear Windows notifications, but nothing is visible on the monitor.

subject: Display stopped showing anything
description: I was already working when the picture disappeared. The PC did not restart and my keyboard lights are still active.

subject: Gets worse near end of shift
description: The computer is fine when first turned on, but after several hours it gets very warm and begins freezing for a few seconds at a time.

subject: Performance returns after cooling
description: The workstation becomes sluggish and the fan gets loud after long use, but it works normally again after being left off for a while.

subject: Warm machine becomes unstable
description: The PC gradually heats up during the day and applications start hanging more often as the temperature rises.

subject: Never gets beyond startup
description: The display works and shows the Windows logo, but the loading process stays there and the login page never appears.

subject: Recovery instead of desktop
description: Every time the workstation starts, I can see the normal boot screens before it enters repair mode rather than Windows.

subject: Boot keeps repeating
description: The PC shows the manufacturer logo, starts loading Windows, and then begins the same startup process again.

subject: Second drive suddenly missing
description: Windows opens normally, but the drive where I keep project files is no longer shown on the computer.

subject: Local files throwing errors
description: The workstation and applications work, but documents stored on one local disk cannot be opened anymore.

subject: External storage invisible
description: I plugged in the external drive I use every week, but Windows does not detect it even after trying another USB port.

subject: Restarted during simple work
description: The workstation rebooted while I was reading email. It had only been running for a short time and was not warm.

subject: Random shutdown with normal temperature
description: The PC suddenly switched off during data entry even though the fan sounded normal and the machine did not feel hot.

subject: Back at login unexpectedly
description: I was already working in Windows, then everything disappeared and a short time later the sign-in screen appeared again.

subject: Completely offline at one desk
description: The computer itself works, but no website, email service, or online company application can be reached.

subject: Network never came back
description: The connection disappeared earlier today and the workstation has remained unable to reach anything online since.

subject: No connected services available
description: Local programs open normally, but anything requiring the network fails completely.

subject: Connected but painfully slow
description: Websites still open and email works, but everything online takes much longer than usual to respond.

subject: Connection drops for a few seconds
description: The workstation keeps losing network access briefly and then reconnecting without me doing anything.

subject: Internet works inconsistently
description: Sometimes pages load normally and other times they pause for a long time before eventually finishing.

subject: Only corporate access is failing
description: Public websites and email work normally, but I cannot connect to the private company environment.

subject: Remote access rejects updated password
description: I changed my expired password and it works for email, but the secure company connection still refuses it.

subject: Internet fine but VPN unavailable
description: My home connection is stable and websites work, but the remote connection required for internal systems will not establish.

subject: Program freezes after opening record
description: The application starts normally, but once I search for a customer and open the result it stops responding.

subject: Software dies during normal use
description: The program launches successfully, but it unexpectedly closes when I try to complete an ordinary task.

subject: Application stuck processing request
description: The software is already open, but after submitting a request it stays on a loading screen indefinitely.

subject: Installer never completes
description: The application is not currently installed. Setup begins normally but stops with an error before finishing.

subject: Cannot get software installed
description: I downloaded the approved installer, but the process fails halfway and the program never appears on the workstation.

subject: Setup closes before completion
description: The installation wizard starts copying files and then exits unexpectedly before the software is installed.

subject: Upgrade keeps failing
description: The existing software still opens, but every attempt to install the newer version ends before the update finishes.

subject: Old version remains after patch attempt
description: The program works, but the required update will not apply and the workstation stays on the previous release.

subject: Cannot move to latest version
description: The application is already installed and usable, but installation of the new release repeatedly fails.

subject: Wrong default folder after transfer
description: The application opens normally, but it still saves files to the location used by my previous team.

subject: Toolbar disappeared after setting change
description: The software itself works, but the toolbar I normally use is gone after I changed some settings.

subject: Program pointing to old environment
description: The application launches without errors, but it is still configured to connect to the server used by our previous department.

subject: Product says not activated
description: The application opens successfully, but several features are disabled because the software says activation is required.

subject: License vanished after reinstall
description: The program was installed again without errors and now opens normally, but it no longer recognizes our company license.

subject: Serial key suddenly requested
description: The software is already installed and starts correctly, but it now asks for a product key before allowing full use.

subject: Forgot password after vacation
description: I returned from leave and cannot remember my work password, so I need to create a new one.

subject: Password reached expiration
description: The account is still active, but the system says my password has expired and must be changed.

subject: Need to replace forgotten credentials
description: I know my username but cannot remember the password I used previously and need to reset it.

subject: Known password keeps getting rejected
description: My account is not locked and I know the current password, but the application repeatedly says the credentials are invalid.

subject: New password rejected at login
description: The password change completed successfully, but the replacement password still fails when I try to authenticate.

subject: Credentials work nowhere on login
description: The sign-in page loads normally, but my usual username and password combination is being refused.

subject: Need first-time access to project tool
description: My normal company account works, but I have never been given access to the application required for my new project.

subject: New employee needs system account
description: I can sign into the company portal, but an account for the department's separate system has not been created for me.

subject: Never had access to this service
description: This is my first time being assigned work in the system and I do not yet have an account for it.

subject: Correct password but account locked
description: I now know the right password, but the login page says the account itself is locked because of earlier failed attempts.

subject: Profile inactive after leave
description: I returned to work and the system recognizes my username but says the account is inactive.

subject: User disabled at sign in
description: The login screen reports that my account has been disabled and will not allow authentication to continue.

subject: Verification goes to old device
description: My password is accepted, but the second login approval is being sent to a phone I no longer use.

subject: Authenticator enrollment fails
description: The account credentials work, but I cannot complete setup of the required two-step verification.

subject: No code arriving for second step
description: The first login step succeeds, but I never receive the verification code required to finish signing in.

subject: Can view but cannot edit
description: I can sign into the application and open the records, but my account is not permitted to make changes.

subject: New role missing required permission
description: My existing account works normally, but after changing responsibilities I still cannot access the section needed for my new duties.

subject: Approval button blocked
description: I can open and review the request, but submitting approval is unavailable because my account lacks the required permission.
